main_staff.abstract:
Sectional curvature bounds are of central importance in the study of Riemannian
manifolds, both in smooth diﬀerential geometry and in the generalized synthetic setting
of Alexandrov spaces. Riemannian metrics along with metric spaces of bounded sectional
curvature enjoy a variety of, oftentimes rigid, geometric properties. The purpose of this
article is to introduce and discuss a new notion of sectional curvature bounds for manifolds
equipped with continuous Riemannian metrics of Geroch–Traschen regularity, i.e., H1
loc ∩
C0, based on a distributional version of the classical formula. Our main result states
that for g ∈C1, this new notion recovers the corresponding bound based on triangle
comparison in the sense of Alexandrov. A weaker version of this statement is also proven
for locally Lipschitz continuous metrics.
Keywords: Sectional curvature bounds, tensor distributions, Alexandrov spaces, CAT,
CBB, Toponogov’s theorem
